entries.reason: Not a claim about data. `why` is a REJECTION CLASS from middleware and this is the prompt shown when there is no rejection to explain — the owner simply arrived at the login. It asserts nothing about any record.
Names OUR gap and says so. A snapshot published without a resolvable HEAD is a fact about our publisher, and the wording puts it there rather than implying the SHA does not exist.

The FIX for a prior `not scheduled` default, recorded rather than removed because the sweep matches any sentence-shaped fallback. A null nextCycleDueAt means the heartbeat did not carry one; the wording attributes the gap to our record and never claims the scheduler has nothing due.

Names OUR gap. `openedOn` is null when the tracker never captured an opened date (docs/tracker-opened.json records 225 unrecoverable), so this says we did not record it — never that the row has no age.

Not an absence. The default fires when a link carries no LABEL, and a link with no label is one on the candidate's own domain — where "official site" and "campaign site" describe exactly the thing that IS present. The label exists for the two cases where those words would be false: RULING 122's page a party publishes about a candidate, and RULING 145's campaign presence on a platform, both of which name their host instead. So the ?? is choosing between two true descriptions of a link that is there, never standing in front of one that is missing — and when there is no link, neither branch renders at all.
